description: Generate a scannable ISO 18004 QR code (SVG vector and/or base64 PNG data URI) for any URL, wallet address, payment URI, or text up to 271 bytes. $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for terms, then call again with `payment`.

ecc.description: Optional error correction level: L, M (default), Q, or H.

format.description: Optional output format: svg (default), png, or both.

size.description: Optional image size in pixels (64-1024, default 256).

text.description: Text, URL, wallet address, or payment URI to encode.

name: qr_generate
title: Qr generate
